name: Pilaf
body:
Station and Complexity line cook 4, rotisseur 4

Flavor Profiles salty, temperature, texture, temperature
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, sour, spicy, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

Pilaf is a combination pasta and rice dish that requires good timing and temperature control to make.

When consumed, it grants DR 1/–. This Damage Reduction increases by +1 for every 3 culinarian levels beyond 7th, to a maximum of DR 5/– at 19th level. At the end of the duration, the consumer is fatigued for 1 minute. A creature can’t benefit from consuming pilaf while fatigued or exhausted.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each.
